Blend opacity controls the panel backdrop\'s tint strength, blend lightness its color (below 100% darker, above lighter), blur radius the frost, glass opacity the card material\'s darkening/tint/highlights, and glass tone its base cast (luminance, brightness, backdrop saturation — the grey-ish look that survives even at 0% opacity; lower is lighter). All apply to whichever system material mode is active.
